note: On the Icefields Parkway (Hwy 93) south of Jasper, two wooded loops beside Honeymoon Lake; the upper loop (sites 21-36) runs within about 30 m of the shore and a short trail leads to a lakeside day-use area. Site 24 is for touring cyclists only. --Claude
